articles.title: Apple Opens CarPlay To Multiple AI Assistants And Expands Auto Strategy
articles.description:
Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is opening CarPlay to third-party AI chatbots, including ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Anthropic's Claude.
This is the first time non Apple voice assistants will be accessible directly within the CarPlay interface.
The move comes alongside Apple's acquisition of Israeli AI startup Q.AI and a partnership with Google focused on Siri.
Together, these steps point to a broader push into automotive AI and conversational tools across Apple's ecosystem.
